model.name: qwen3-coder-next-q4km (agent)
model.about: Alibaba Qwen3-Coder-Next, mixture of experts (80B, about 3B active; hybrid linear and full attention), Q4_K_M GGUF as published by Qwen, served with llama.cpp. Apache-2.0. About 48 GB, so one A100. Instruct only, no thinking. llama.cpp cannot force a named tool, so the agent's last 'submit now' request runs with tool_choice auto.

SELECT 
    CHNL.DSPLY_NM AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN TXN
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CHNL CHNL ON TXN.CHNL_K = CHNL.CHNL_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT DT ON TXN.BUS_DT_K = DT.DT_K
WHERE DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
  AND CHNL.IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CHNL.DSPLY_NM

JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT d ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K

WITH customer_versions AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_ID,
        VRSN_NBR,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        IS_CURR,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (PARTITION BY BUS_ID ORDER BY VRSN_NBR) AS PREV_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL
),
current_vs_prev AS (
    SELECT 
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_segment,
        PREV_SGMNT_CD1 AS previous_segment
    FROM customer_versions
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
      AND PREV_SGMNT_CD1 IS NOT NULL
      AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 <> PREV_SGMNT_CD1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM current_vs_prev;

WITH quarterly_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        ft.CUST_K,
        EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dd.CAL_DT) AS quarter
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN ft
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON ft.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
    WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
      AND ft.CUST_K IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ft.CUST_K, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dd.CAL_DT)
),
customers_in_all_quarters AS (
    SELECT CUST_K
    FROM quarterly_customers
    WHERE quarter IN (1, 2, 3, 4)
    GROUP BY CUST_K
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT quarter) = 4
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_in_all_quarters_2025
FROM customers_in_all_quarters;

WITH customers_with_disputes AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
        SELECT DT_K 
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT 
        WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    )
    AND CUST_K IS NOT NULL
),
customers_with_wire_transfers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    WHERE BUS_DT_K IN (
        SELECT DT_K 
        FROM bank_dwh.D_DT 
        WHERE CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    )
    AND CUST_K IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.CUST_K) AS distinct_customers
FROM customers_with_disputes d
LEFT JOIN customers_with_wire_transfers w ON d.CUST_K = w.CUST_K
WHERE w.CUST_K IS NULL;

WITH june_2024 AS (
  SELECT LN_ID, DYS_PST_DUE
  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20240630
),
june_2025 AS (

  FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D
  WHERE BUS_DT_K = 20250630
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS loan_count

WHERE j24.DYS_PST_DUE = 0

WITH ranked_transfers AS (
    SELECT 
        CCY_CD1,
        ORGNL_AMT,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1 ORDER BY ORGNL_AMT) AS rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY CCY_CD1) AS cnt
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT ON F_WR_TRF.BUS_DT_K = bank_dwh.D_DT.DT_K
    WHERE bank_dwh.D_DT.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
),
median_calc AS (
    SELECT 
        CCY_CD1,
        ORGNL_AMT,
        rn,
        cnt,
        CASE 
            WHEN cnt % 2 = 1 THEN (cnt + 1) / 2
            ELSE cnt / 2
        END AS mid1,
        CASE 
            WHEN cnt % 2 = 0 THEN cnt / 2 + 1
            ELSE (cnt + 1) / 2
        END AS mid2
    FROM ranked_transfers
)
SELECT 
    CCY_CD1,
    AVG(ORGNL_AMT) AS median_amount
FROM median_calc
WHERE rn IN (mid1, mid2)
GROUP BY CCY_CD1
ORDER BY CCY_CD1;

WITH channel_txn_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        D.CAL_YR_NBR AS year,
        COUNT(*) AS txn_count
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN F
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT D ON F.BUS_DT_K = D.DT_K
    WHERE F.CHNL_K = 3
    GROUP BY D.CAL_YR_NBR
),
counts_2024_2025 AS (
    SELECT 
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN txn_count END) AS count_2024,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2025 THEN txn_count END) AS count_2025
    FROM channel_txn_counts
)
SELECT 
    100.0 * (count_2025 - count_2024) / count_2024 AS growth_percentage
FROM counts_2024_2025;

WITH last_snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        dd.CAL_YR_NBR,
        dd.MTH_NBR,
        MAX(dd.CAL_DT) AS last_snapshot_date
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dd ON f.BUS_DT_K = dd.DT_K
    WHERE dd.CAL_YR_NBR = 2025
    GROUP BY dd.CAL_YR_NBR, dd.MTH_NBR
)
SELECT 
    ls.MTH_NBR AS month_number,
    SUM(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS total_closing_balance
FROM last_snapshots ls
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D f ON f.BUS_DT_K = (
    SELECT dd2.DT_K 
    FROM bank_dwh.D_DT dd2 
    WHERE dd2.CAL_DT = ls.last_snapshot_date
)
GROUP BY ls.MTH_NBR
ORDER BY ls.MTH_NBR;

FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST d
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN f ON d.CUST_K = f.CUST_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT dt ON f.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K

        SUM(f.STLM_AMT) AS total_stlm_amt,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 ORDER BY SUM(f.STLM_AMT) DESC) AS rn

WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM d.CAL_DT) = 2025
